name: Sweet Nothings
source:
A sweet and romantic adventure awaits you! 

You come across an abandoned copy of an old visual novel from the 2000's and decide to give it a try. Surely nothing bad will happen, right?

[From [url=https://turtle-squad.itch.io/sweet-nothings]itch.io[/url]]
